title: Wealth Tax Simulator
header_description: Many countries levy a tax on personal net wealth. Wealth taxes target accumulated assets — such as real estate, investments, and cash — and can complement income taxes by taxing capital rather than labour. Properly designed wealth taxes (with exemptions and progressive rates) can increase progressivity and help reduce inequality. Select a region and enter your total personal wealth to estimate the annual wealth tax using that region's rules.
